name: G. B. Woodworking
old_description: GB Woodworking, founded in 1982, is the continuation of a lifelong passion for working with wood.
about:
GB Woodworking, based in Boston, Massachusetts, was founded in 1982 by Gary Barcus as the continuation of a lifelong passion for working with wood. The owner-operated shop has served the Greater Boston area for over four decades.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom architectural millwork and cabinetry for residential projects. Its capabilities include built-in bedroom furniture, bookcases, home office systems, and closet doors. Work is completed in the company's shop using finishes such as precatalyzed lacquers, waterborne alkyd enamels, conversion varnishes, and catalyzed urethanes, then installed on-site with care to protect the client's home. Typical installations take one to two days, while larger rooms may require up to a week.

GB Woodworking serves homeowners and interior designers across communities including Boston, Brookline, Newton, Wellesley, Weston, and Pride's Crossing. The owner has collaborated with many of the area's top interior designers, translating design drawings into finished millwork.

Barcus emphasizes a client-first approach, offering no-cost design consultations, requiring no more than a 30% deposit, and providing shop drawings or samples for approval before fabrication begins. He personally oversees design, shop work, and installation, ensuring every piece receives his direct attention.
